blocks.text:
To: Barbara Hall
Cc: Jeffrey Ochoa, Megan Dudley

The census extract your office sent over loaded without trouble, and the active count ties to your summary. We can build the study on this file. A small number of records need a definition from your side before we rely on them, and I have set those out below.

Megan Dudley reconciled the file against the Estes Group payroll register yesterday, and the two agree line for line except for one group. A handful of participants carry a status code we cannot read with confidence. A study is only as sound as the census beneath it, so we would like the reading confirmed before we treat those records as final. The {{fact:f:E-2019-001.client}} data are otherwise clean.
Before we close out the census, could your office confirm the following:

items: Whether the flagged status code marks deferred vested participants or terminations with no vested benefit.
Whether the mid-year rehires should keep their original hire dates, or the later ones, for the service count.

blocks.text: Nothing on the assumptions is settled, and you will see that work before any result depends on it. Jeffrey Ochoa is building the model in parallel, so these two confirmations are the only items holding up the next step. Once they are settled, Megan Dudley closes the census and we move on to the experience counts.
